note: Domain Access Simple Sitemap bridges simple_sitemap and domain_access. Its own config object domain_simple_sitemap.settings has two booleans: domain_simple_sitemap_filter (node source vs node access filter) and domain_simple_sitemap_replace_homepage (rewrite front-page URL; needs domain_config/domain_site_settings). Settings UI /admin/config/domain/domain_simple_sitemap/config (route domain_simple_sitemap.settings, permission 'administer domains'). Per domain the DomainSitemapManager creates a simple_sitemap_type + simple_sitemap variant whose id equals the domain id, using the domain_entity url generator, with third-party setting domain_simple_sitemap.sitemap_domain = <domain id>. This site has no Domain entities, so the hard case is grounded in the module's real data model: creating the sitemap type + variant (with the sitemap_domain third-party setting) that the manager produces for a domain id, verified against live config entities. Baseline: domain_simple_sitemap_filter = 0, domain_simple_sitemap_replace_homepage = 0; no dss_* sitemap type/variant.

evals.prompt: What are the two configuration options provided by the domain_simple_sitemap module, and where do you set them?
evals.expected_output: domain_simple_sitemap.settings has two booleans: domain_simple_sitemap_filter (filter the domain sitemap by node source instead of node access) and domain_simple_sitemap_replace_homepage (rewrite the domain front-page link to the domain base URL; needs domain_config or domain_site_settings). Set them at /admin/config/domain/domain_simple_sitemap/config (route domain_simple_sitemap.settings, permission 'administer domains').

evals.prompt: How does domain_simple_sitemap represent a domain's sitemap, and when is it created automatically?
evals.expected_output: For each Domain it creates a simple_sitemap_type and a simple_sitemap variant whose id equals the domain id, using the domain_entity URL generator, and tags the type with third-party setting domain_simple_sitemap.sitemap_domain = <domain id>. It is created automatically on hook_domain_insert (and removed on hook_domain_delete) via the DomainSitemapManager service.

evals.prompt: I installed domain_simple_sitemap after I already had several domains. How do I create sitemap variants for those existing domains?
evals.expected_output: On the settings form (/admin/config/domain/domain_simple_sitemap/config) click 'Generate domain's sitemap variants', which batch-runs DomainSitemapManager::addSitemapVariant() for every active domain. Programmatically you can call the domain_simple_sitemap.manager service's addSitemapVariant() per domain. Then rebuild via Simple Sitemap's 'Rebuild queue & generate'.

evals.prompt: On this site, is domain_simple_sitemap configured to filter domain sitemaps by node source or by node access? Inspect the live configuration and give the value of the relevant setting.
evals.expected_output: By node source: domain_simple_sitemap.settings:domain_simple_sitemap_filter is 1 (TRUE) on this site, which means 'use node source instead of node access as filter'.

evals.prompt: Is domain_simple_sitemap currently set to replace a domain's front-page URL with the domain base URL in generated sitemaps on this site? Inspect the live configuration and name the setting.

Create the domain sitemap that domain_simple_sitemap would produce for a domain whose id is dss_eval: a simple_sitemap_type with id dss_eval (using the domain_entity url generator and carrying the third-party setting domain_simple_sitemap.sitemap_domain = dss_eval) and a matching simple_sitemap variant with id dss_eval. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Mirror DomainSitemapManager::addSitemapVariant(): create a simple_sitemap_type 'dss_eval' (sitemap_generator 'default', url_generators including 'domain_entity') with setThirdPartySetting('domain_simple_sitemap','sitemap_domain','dss_eval'), then a simple_sitemap variant 'dss_eval' of that type with status TRUE. Verified by the type existing with that third-party setting and the variant existing.

evals.prompt: On my multi-domain site I want each domain's sitemap to be decided by the content's Domain Source field rather than by domain access. Configure domain_simple_sitemap for that and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set domain_simple_sitemap.settings:domain_simple_sitemap_filter to 1 (TRUE) (drush cset domain_simple_sitemap.settings domain_simple_sitemap_filter 1, or tick 'Use node source instead of node access as filter' on the settings form).
